name: Agent Identity & Privilege Abuse
description: Reuse, escalation or impersonation of an agent's identity and credentials — shared service accounts, over-scoped tokens, or credentials harvested from agent configuration — so actions execute with more authority than the task requires.
differs: Distinguished from Agentic Tool Misuse (T3.001): the tool call may be legitimate, but the identity and scope under which it executes is the defect.
